comment: Buttons & Gestures settings surface (S10+ / beyond2lte). bg-03 owns this contract and the state machine it describes; briq-06d renders the page in the Settings app. This is an APPEND POINT, not a second settings store: every value here is persisted in the A32 file /etc/nuxel/input/buttons.json, which the button manager reads and which no UI may rewrite with anything except a value from the option list below.

timing_source.why: The timing windows are the state machine's contract and are cross-checked against the protected A32 source by the offline test. The UI DISPLAYS them (read-only) so the owner can see what a 'long press' means; it never edits them.

fields.label: Power: short press
fields.help: A32 behaviour: dispatched immediately on release, no deferral.

fields.label: Power: long press
fields.help: Opens the Nuxel power menu (lock/screenshot/restart/power-off/recovery entries).

fields.label: Power: double press
fields.help: Deferred by the double-press gap so a single press is not mistaken for a double.

fields.label: Volume up: hold
fields.help: Default opens the notifications panel. Choosing *-autorepeat restores the exact A32 key-repeat cadence (400 ms then every 250 ms).

fields.label: Bixby: press
fields.help: Deferred by the 400 ms double-press gap to disambiguate press vs double press.

fields.label: Bixby: double press
fields.help: Dispatched as a REQUEST to the camera/flashlight arbitration (briq-08c); it never claims the LED lit.

fields.label: Bixby: hold during startup
fields.needs: early boot stage (initramfs/BOOT key capture) - BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED
fields.help: One-time verbose boot for that boot only; never persisted. Honoured only when the early boot stage captures the key - otherwise it is reported BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED (briq-02b owns the consumer).

fields.label: Power + Volume up (hold)
fields.needs: the vibrator path for audible-silent modes (briq-08b) and the audio path (briq-03c)

fields.label: Power + Volume down (hold)
fields.help: Never intercepts Samsung's own hardware reset combo (no EVIOCGRAB is taken); the FSM's own classes are cancelled for the rest of the hold.

fields.label: Hold volume to repeat
fields.help: Off by default: a hold opens a panel instead. Turning it on restores continuous volume ramping for owners who want the A32 feel.

shows: the capability-resolved keypad and touchscreen nodes (never a fixed /dev/input/eventN)
the last FSM action, its source and the refusal reason for a gated entry

honesty: A saved mapping is a stored preference: it is not proof that the keys work on the handset.
Physical press behaviour is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST - the offline tests replay recorded traces only.
Recovery / Download Mode entries and the reboot class are REFUSED by policy; the page shows the refusal reason instead of a toggle it cannot honour.
conflict_rule: bg-03 owns configs/nuxel/buttons/**, configs/nuxel/input/** and tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-button-manager.c + nuxel-button-fsm.h; briq-06d owns pwa/nuxel-apps/settings/**.
